sections.content: How many people are "debt, rent and other cash collectors"?

17,200 people

were counted on the census as "debt, rent and other cash collectors" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Debt, rent and other cash collectors collect payments due or overdue from households and businesses and empty cash from prepayment meters or machines.

People who had this job were generally similar in age to the working population

The occupation of "debt, rent and other cash collectors" had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 25 to 29 years. Of the whole working population 11.1% were aged 25 to 29 years. For people working as "debt, rent and other cash collectors", 12.5% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "debt, rent and other cash collectors" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "debt, rent and other cash collectors" included:

  • records clerks and assistants
  • plant and machine operatives (other)
  • assemblers and routine operatives (other)

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

A similar number of men and women had this job

Among people working as "debt, rent and other cash collectors" there were a similar number of men and women (53% compared with 47%).

This means "debt, rent and other cash collectors" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "sales occupations".

Men made up 53% and women made up 47% of "debt, rent and other cash collectors"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women. This occupation was one of the jobs for which the proportion of men and women was closest to this overall picture.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "debt, rent and other cash collectors" included:

  • taxation experts
  • newspaper and periodical broadcast journalists and reporters
  • horticultural trades

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "debt, rent and other cash collectors" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged 50 years and older, we see there is a higher proportion of men with this occupation than women.

The percentage of men and women who are "debt, rent and other cash collectors" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "debt, rent and other cash collectors", 13.1% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (76% compared with 24%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (91.1%) than self-employed (8.9%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the North West. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Birmingham, this is in the region of the West Midlands.
